S03.reviewer: Arena assistant: actual-pixel independent chronological-frame reassessment; NOT a human approval
observations: Re-inspected all four exterior chronological frames, including enlarged real window crops, not just the three-frame detail strip. Upper-window guest changes from low arms to both arms raised; lower-window guest also changes arm pose. The model claim that all silhouettes remain static is demonstrably false.

Fog and silhouettes visibly change while the street camera moves; the later empty interior is an establishing/transition view, not a substitute for an entirely still clip. Period street, warm party windows and gramophone match the January gathering narration. No identity-bearing foreground character, modern objects, gore or text.

S05.reviewer: Arena assistant: actual-pixel independent chronological-frame reassessment; NOT a human approval
observations: Across the actual chronological frames the door rotates from wide open through a narrow gap to nearly shut, while fog and hat feathers move independently. The automated review incorrectly characterized this as the opposite action.

The actual narration says Cora was not seen again after the party; it does NOT narrate that the door must visibly latch. The empty corridor and abandoned purple feathered hat support absence. A nearly shut door at the sampled endpoint is not a material story contradiction. No visible person, gore, text or wardrobe drift.
